_source: Generated by fixtures/voice/gen_h264_rtp_vectors.py: RFC 6184 packetization mode 1 (single NAL unit, STAP-A, FU-A), RFC 4588 RTX, and rtpsize transport sealing with pycryptodome, written independently of the Rust code under test. Fabricated key, SSRCs and frames; no Discord traffic. The one-byte header extension block (abs-send-time 3, playout-delay 6, content-type 7, RID 11; RTX: 3 and repaired-RID 12) is part of the encrypted body.
